summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of iteration 3 (Times Tables). Verified new OpPicker on home (op-mul/op-div/op-mixed, blue highlight on selection, persists across reload via localStorage). Long-form tiles (mode-long-mul, mode-long-div) navigate to /play/long-mul and /play/long-div. Learn page exposes all 5 tabs (tab-table, tab-flash, tab-choices, tab-skip, tab-drill). Flashcards: 12-card cycle (1×n…12×n), flip via flash-card, knew/missed advance, flash-done with flash-restart, reshuffles when picking a different table. Multiple choice: 4 buttons (data-testid choice-{value}) plus container choice-grid; correct selection turns emerald-500, wrong selection turns red-500 and reveals the correct answer in green; score counter increments. Skip-counting: skip-input + skip-submit work, score increments on correct answer with sequence reshuffle. Drill tab still functional. Long Multiplication: brief screen with diff-easy/diff-medium/diff-hard, 8-question round, coin reward = 3/5/8 per correct (verified easy: +24, medium: +40, hard would be +64), end shows long-mul-result with long-mul-again. Long Division: same flow, hard difficulty 8 correct gave +64 coins; long-div-result shows; Play-again returns to long-div-brief. RangeSelector no longer renders op chips (op-mul lives inside op-picker). No console errors observed. Coins increment correctly: flashcard knew-it +1, choices correct +1, skip correct +1, long-mul/div per difficulty.
critical_code_review_comments: LongMul.jsx and LongDiv.jsx import useEffect but never use it (unused import). Cosmetic — no functional impact.

generateLongMul/generateLongDiv use a 30-iteration anti-repeat loop and only check lastKey; for medium difficulty (10–99 × 10–99) the keyspace is huge so the fallback (12×13) is essentially unreachable, but for easy long-mul (16×8 = 128 unique pairs) repeats are more likely after many rounds. Acceptable.

ChoicesView builds the round in useState(buildRound) and again immediately in useEffect on mount — produces a brief double-render of two different rounds (no visual flicker observed but a tiny waste). Minor.
Learn.jsx FlashView/ChoicesView/SkipView each implement near-identical 'reset on n change' patterns; could be DRY'd into a useResetOnDep hook.
Skip-counting: blank index is uniformly random in [1, length-2] so the first and last positions are never blank — works as designed but worth documenting (the input is never the last visible cell).

data-testid='choice-grid' on the container div uses the same prefix as the four 'choice-{value}' option buttons; selectors using [data-testid^="choice-"] will match the grid too. Consider renaming the container to e.g. 'choices-grid' to keep prefix-matching test selectors clean.

Long mul/div input accepts only the standard <input> from Question.jsx; no specific length/maxLength applied. With hard 3×2 multiplication, a 5-digit answer is fine in current width but worth noting on small mobile breakpoints.
seed_data_creation: Cleared localStorage between tests. Read tt_arena_state_v2.coins to assert coin deltas.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 ships clean. Notes for future selectors: container 'choice-grid' shares prefix with 'choice-{value}' buttons — use [data-testid^='choice-']:not([data-testid='choice-grid']) or restrict to button[data-testid^='choice-']. AnimatePresence on Learn keys by `${tab}-${n}` so switching the table briefly keeps the exiting view in the DOM (~150ms); add a 300ms+ wait after learn-pick-N before reading inner_text. Long-mul reward map: easy=3, medium=5, hard=8 coins per correct. Long-div same map. flash knew=+1, choices correct=+1, skip correct=+1.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All 14 listed feature points verified end-to-end.
